posts.en:
browser-automation is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Real-browser automation for dsh via an MCP server (Playwright core): navigate, click, fill, type, screenshot, and act on accessibility snapshots with numbered references - all 22 web_* tools re-exposed to the harness over stdio.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-303d7469a1bb7484a4c1.html
